Transfer: €165,000
Workshop of 95 m², with 4 meters of facade, fully conditioned, it has 2 refrigerators, 2 freezers, 2 cold rooms (one positive cold and the other negative cold), kneading and beating machine, dehydrator, laminator, 4 gas burners, 2 microwaves and two convection ovens. It also has a toilet, changing room, air conditioning, storage room and a 20m² patio.

Incasol deposit: 2 months
Additional guarantee: to be valued.
